backgrounds.name: Wanderer
backgrounds.description: You learned to read trails, weather and the needs of a long road.

feature.name: Trail Sense
feature.detail: You can identify the safest visible route through familiar wilderness.

backgrounds.name: Apothecary's Helper
backgrounds.description: You prepared remedies and learned the names of useful plants.

feature.name: Field Notes
feature.detail: You can recognize common medicinal plants and preserve a safe sample.

backgrounds.name: Harbor Hand
backgrounds.description: You worked among ropes, cargo and changing tides.

feature.name: Steady Haul
feature.detail: You know practical ways to secure cargo and judge a safe passage.

backgrounds.name: Archive Apprentice
backgrounds.description: You copied records and learned how to find a useful fact.

feature.name: Cross-reference
feature.detail: You can quickly organize notes and identify gaps in a written account.

backgrounds.name: Road Envoy
backgrounds.description: You carried messages between people who did not always agree.

feature.name: Neutral Introduction
feature.detail: You know how to open a conversation without claiming authority.

backgrounds.name: Camp Provisioner
backgrounds.description: You kept a traveling group supplied, fed and ready to move.

feature.name: Measured Rations
feature.detail: You can estimate ordinary travel provisions for a known group.
